title: Flown-Coupon Allowance Schedule, Late Enrollment Bonuses of Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements
content:
**Schedule.** A late enrollment bonus on a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement earns a coupon allowance from the flown coupons on the company's tickets, placed by flight date, in the enrollment coupon window of 12 calendar months up to and including the credit date. The flown coupons are those in the fare ledger of the company's tickets under Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand. The enrollment-bonus lateness is the number of whole calendar months from the agreement's approval date to the credit date.

| Lateness | Flown coupons in the window | Coupon allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 6 months or more | 30 or more | 500 points |
| 6 months or more | 15 or more, fewer than 30 | 300 points |
| 6 months or more | fewer than 15 | none |
| fewer than 6 months | any | none |

**How the allowance acts.** The allowance is added, in points, to the enrollment bonus as it stands after any percentage uplift has been applied and rounded — the bonus before allowances. Allowances on different grounds are added together.

### Cases (hypothetical)

- Lateness of 7 months and 30 flown coupons: allowance of 500 points; a bonus before allowances of 2625 points becomes 3125 points.
- Lateness of 7 months and 29 flown coupons: allowance of 300 points.
- Lateness of 5 months and 40 flown coupons: no allowance.
